title: Auto-merge that cannot leave a PR stuck: race-proof merge step and a reconciler
goal: Median open-to-merge is already ~60s; the real risks are PRs that never merge: (1) the merge job exits 0 with 'no open PR whose head is <sha>' when Test finishes before the PR is opened, (2) a refused merge comments once and stops, (3) a dropped workflow_run event has no recovery. Move the merge logic into scripts/auto-merge-pr.sh (merge, classify a refusal as conflict/other, comment once per head sha), call it from the merge job AND from the open-pr job when a green push run for the sha already exists, and add scripts/reconcile-prs.sh on a 10-minute schedule: merge PRs whose head has a green push run, comment once on red/conflicting PRs, skip wip/nopr/dependabot/draft, close PRs idle for 7 days that are not green (branch kept). Tests drive both scripts through a fake gh.
